text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
—With that, the seminar concludes. 
Afterward, a social gathering will be held 
in Hall C, so please wait in the foyer.

Moving between venues as instructed, I let 
out a breath, excitement still lingering. 
...Learned so much!

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, <username>, you came too! Man, what an 
incredible seminar... Getting to hear from 
legends like that!

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Not just from a Trainer's perspective, but 
tales about their trainee horse girls back 
then too... Calling it 'informative' 
doesn't even do it justice!

I nod vigorously at my colleagues' 
remarks. On top of that—for such 
high-level event, entry fee was 
practically free.

Who made such gathering possible? Glancing 
at handout's corner, first name under 
'Special Thanks' reads—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Hello and welcome. I am Saint Light.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
To everyone gathered here. Please—have a 
wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
May this evening illuminate your future, 
and that of the horse girls, even if just 
a little.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: —Here's to our future!

text_block_list.name: Seminar Organizer
text_block_list.text:
—Saint Light-san, thank you very much for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Seminar Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Holding such a high-level seminar was 
possible entirely thanks to your generous 
support. Truly... how can I ever thank you 
enough?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
I scrutinize every investment destination. 
In short—your words moved me.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Visiting my estate immediately after my 
initial reply was also quite commendable.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is hot. You did not 
miss your chance. And that brought us to 
today.

text_block_list.name: Seminar Organizer
text_block_list.text:
...Such kind words. By the way, leaving 
already? Joining the mixer—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
No, just paying greetings. Waiting for me 
back at the manor—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
are works of romantic literature. 
Fufufu...

Noticing the host bowing respectfully, I 
hurriedly follow suit. Such nobility made 
it impossible for a mere attendee like me 
to speak to her.
choice_data_list:
At least learn everything I can before 
leaving!
Appreciate her and enjoy the mixer

text_block_list.text:
First Triple Crown horse girl Saint Light, 
possessing the face of a wonderful patron.

Grateful for her blessing, I eagerly 
returned to the venue, asking veteran 
trainers countless questions.

Saint Light, noble in purpose, yet 
somewhat whimsical.

Best way to repay her feelings is enjoying 
and learning. Deciding so, I returned to 
the mixer venue.
